description:
## Why This Exists

store/overview.rs::message_ids_since() fetches ALL rows from the overview table (WHERE message_id \!= '') and then filters by wildmat and date in Rust. For a server with millions of articles, NEWNEWS will cause a full table scan every call.

The date_header column stores RFC 2822 strings, not Unix timestamps, so SQL cannot filter by date directly. The fix requires storing the parsed date as a Unix timestamp column, adding an index on it, and pushing the filter into SQL.

## Acceptance Criteria

Add a date_ts column (integer, indexed) to the overview table. Populate it at insert time. query in message_ids_since uses WHERE date_ts > ? instead of fetching all rows.
title: overview::message_ids_since full table scan: no date-based index
